title: Antimicrobial silver nanoparticle-doped poly(vinyl alcohol)/guar gum/gum ghatti nanocomposites: a multifaceted step towards sustainable packaging
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00825E, Paper
Open Access

Veena G. Bhat, Saraswati P. Masti, Shivayogi S. Narasagoudr, Lingaraj Kariyappa Kurabetta, Manjushree Nagaraj Gunaki, Ajitkumar Appayya Hunashyal, Ravindra B. Chougale, Ravindra B. Malabadi
This work develops a sustainable bio-based packaging film using green AgNPs in a PVA/guar gum/gum ghatti blend, improving stability, hydrophobicity, antibacterial activity, and biodegradability.
